passives.name: Prince's Retaliation
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Reduces Critical Hit Chance of Dark enemies. This effect cannot be removed. When hit, reduces the duration of buff(s) granted to all enemies by 1 turn. Greatly reduces damage taken from Striker enemies, but increases damage taken from Mage and Ranger enemies. Increases damage dealt to non-Light enemies and reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Light enemies and increases damage taken from them.

buffs.summary: −50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
+15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
